m: gītā (ā), f. a song, sacred song or poem, religious doctrines declared in metrical form by an inspired sage (cf. Agastya-gītā, Bhagavad-gītā [often called Gītā, Prab. vi, 9/10 &c.], Rāma-gītā, Śiva-gītā)
a: gītā [gai karmaṇi kta] A name given to certain sacred writings in verse (often in the form of a dialogue) which are devoted to the exposition of particular religious and theosophical doctrines; e. g. śivagītā, rāmagītā, bhagavadgītā. But the name appears to be especially confined tothe last, the Bhagavadgītā; gītāsugītā kartavyā kimanyaiḥ śāstravistaraiḥ . yā svayaṃ padmanābhasya mukhapadmādviniḥsṛtā .. quoted by Śrīdharasvāmin.
